page.overview:
What is Nightmare Freddy?

Nightmare Freddy, also referred to as The Bear in the story, appears in Dittophobia, the third and final story of Tales from the Pizzaplex #8: B7-2 as one of the secondary antagonists torturing Rory during his night terrors. It was built by William Afton.

When Rory is having night terrors, Nightmare Freddy is large, frightening, mutilated brown bear wearing a black top hat and bow tie. It has sharp, large teeth and its jaw can open "impossibly wide." But, once the nightmare ends, the Bear is seen as an oversized puppet with tattered fur, hung on a flimsy, metallic skeleton.

In Dittophobia, Freddy is one of the few nightmarish creatures that torture Rory every night as he breaths in hallucinogenic gas. It rises from under Rory's bed and opens its jaw wide to bite down on Rory's flesh. After the gas stops dispensing, Rory finds Freddy housed beneath a trap door hidden by a rug in the bedroom. It is seen to be a mechanically-controlled animatronic puppet, with tears on its fur, revealing more of its flimsy, metallic skeleton that helps it move.

While Nightmare Freddy appears to be a moving animatronic, in reality, the nightmares true forms are mounted suit parts on rolling mechanical stands to emulate animatronics hunting someone, being turned into monsters by illusions as the result of hallucinogenic gas.
